title: Initiative Accordion & Commitment Fabric — cross-team OKR alignment and roadmap gate
creator: Ava Patel
description: Problem: Cross-functional initiatives are inconsistently described and scoped across PM, Eng, and Design, which causes rework during planning gates, missed dependencies, and opaque capacity commitments. Goal: Define a compact, machine-parseable "initiative accordion" template plus a Commitment Fabric protocol to capture who OWNS / SUPPORTS / INFORMS, capacity signals, gating criteria, and dependency surface area. This ticket is to design the template, prototype the intake workflow in Confluence + Linear, and run a pilot with 4 initiatives for the Q4 planning cycle. Desired outcome: 1) A canonical initiative record that feeds the roadmap, release gates, and the dependency registry; 2) A lightweight commitment rubric (OWN/SUPPORT/INFORM) with resourcing expectations and escalation path; 3) Acceptance criteria for gating decisions so leadership can sign off without ambiguous follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: Accordion template implemented in Confluence + example populated for 4 pilot initiatives
Commitment Fabric defined and tested with engineering and design leads (documented RACI-like commitments)
Linear intake flow to require initiative metadata: owner, stakeholders, estimated capacity (FTE wks), dependencies, customer-impact level, and release target
Roadmap gating checklist and decision rubric written; two leadership reviewers have approved
Dependency registry entries created for pilot initiatives and surfaced in roadmap dashboard
